mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tc_job_lease(tenant_id,job_type,business_key,status,next_run_at,created_at,updated_at,trace_parent) VALUES(#{tenant},#{type},#{business},'READY',UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),#{traceParent}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=tc_job_lease.id

INSERT INTO tc_job_lease(tenant_id,job_type,business_key,status,next_run_at,created_at,updated_at,trace_parent) VALUES(#{tenant},#{type},#{business},'READY',#{runAt},UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),#{traceParent}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=tc_job_lease.id
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_job_lease SET wake_generation=wake_generation+1, next_run_at=CASE WHEN status='READY' THEN LEAST(next_run_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ELSE next_run_at END, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND job_type=#{type} AND business_key=#{business} AND status IN ('READY','RUNNING')
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM tc_job_lease WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND job_type=#{type} AND runnable=1 AND next_run_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY next_run_at,id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_job_lease SET status='RUNNING',owner=#{owner}, lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(MICROSECOND,#{leaseMicros},UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)), next_run_at=lease_until,fencing_token=fencing_token+1,attempts=attempts+1, claimed_wake_generation=wake_generation, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND status IN ('READY','RUNNING') AND next_run_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id,job_type,business_key,owner,fencing_token,attempts,lease_until,trace_parent FROM tc_job_lease WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT id,tenant_id,job_type,business_key,owner,fencing_token,attempts,lease_until,trace_parent FROM tc_job_lease WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_job_lease SET status=#{state},owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL, next_run_at=CASE WHEN #{state}='READY' AND wake_generation>claimed_wake_generation THEN UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE TIMESTAMPADD(MICROSECOND,#{delayMicros},UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) END, last_error=#{error},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING' AND owner=#{owner} AND fencing_token=#{token} AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND job_type=#{type} AND business_key=#{business}
mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id,job_type,business_key,owner,fencing_token,attempts,lease_until,trace_parent FROM tc_job_lease WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND job_type='OUTBOX_PUBLISH' AND business_key=#{eventId} AND status='REVIEW' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_job_lease SET status='READY',next_run_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND job_type='OUTBOX_PUBLISH' AND business_key=#{eventId} AND status='REVIEW'
mapper.sql: FROM tc_job_lease WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND job_type='OUTBOX_PUBLISH' AND status=#{state}
mapper.select: SELECT id,business_key,status,attempts,next_run_at,last_error AND id>#{after} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id,business_key,status,attempts,next_run_at,last_error ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
